# eval-dataset-splitter

> Split golden evaluation datasets into train, dev and test partitions by stratum with seeded hashing, group-aware and near-duplicate leakage prevention Python package `eval-dataset-splitter`, import name `eval_dataset_splitter`.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and defense boundaries
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
